message_1_subject: Discovery recap: compliance posture & next steps
message_1_body:
Jordan / Sara,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation. Quick recap of what I heard and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of VitalMed requirements
- PHI scope: ingesting and storing limited PHI (lab results / patient identifiers) — will require a BAA and careful data retention controls.
- Primary certifications requested: SOC 2 Type II report (current or in-flight), explicit HIPAA controls + BAA, GDPR controls for EU patients, and interest in long-term ISO 27001 alignment.
- Procurement timeline: procurement expects vendor security questionnaire returned before the end of Q1 2027; final contract Q2 2027.

Items we committed to provide
1) Completed vendor security questionnaire (I'll attach a template and we can fill in their sheet).
2) Redacted SOC 2 Type II report and control summary.
3) BAA template and confirmation of Redwood's PHI handling pattern (options: hosted with BAA, or Dedicated/Private deployment for stricter isolation).
4) Short FAQ on encryption, KMS/HSM, data residency, retention and incident response.

Next steps (proposed)
- Jordan: share the procurement questionnaire workbook (you mentioned an XLSX) and confirm the format/sections we should prioritize.
- Ben / Marissa: can you review and confirm what we can share externally (redacted SOC2, BAA) and whether we should propose Dedicated for initial pilots with PHI?
- I'll follow up with a completed questionnaire draft + links to redacted SOC2 and BAA by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire-template.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

message_4_subject: Re: Fwd: VitalMed vendor questionnaire — alignment and ask
message_4_body:
Thanks — quick answers and a recommended external package to include with the questionnaire.

1) SOC 2 / artifacts
- We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the 12-month period ending May 2026. Redacted copy is safe to share; it includes control narratives for logical access, change management, and incident response.
- Provide the redacted PDF + a one-page control summary (included).

2) BAA
- Legal has an approved BAA template and we have historically signed BAAs for customers handling PHI. We can sign VitalMed's BAA subject to a standard review; to speed it, offer our DocuSign link with our template and note any material deviations.
- DocuSign BAA link: https://www.docusign.com/templates/baa-redwood

3) Dedicated / Private deployment option for PHI pilot
- We can propose a Dedicated reserved capacity instance (isolated GPU pool + VPC) to address procurement concerns about multi-tenancy. That will require a minimal onboarding SLA and a short architecture review.

4) Encryption / KMS / retention / IR
- Data at rest: AES-256 with customer-shared KMS keys available for Dedicated and Private customers.
- Data in transit: TLS 1.3 for all endpoints.
- KV cache and prompt history: configurable retention; default retention for hosted accounts is 90 days, can be reduced for contract.
- Key management: integrate with customer KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and optional HSM-backed keys for Dedicated.
- Incident response: 24x7 on-call + SLA'ed notification windows for P1 incidents; we provide post-incident reports and for critical incidents participate in scheduled conference calls.

5) ISO / FedRAMP
- ISO 27001: readiness assessment planned for Q2 2027; certification timeline is typically 6–9 months once the program is in motion.
- FedRAMP: not an offering today. If VitalMed requires FedRAMP, we should flag that as a long-lead procurement item and discuss interim mitigations (Dedicated + formal attestation).

Suggested deliverables to include with questionnaire return:
- Completed highlighted rows in their spreadsheet (I recommend focusing on technical controls items first).
- redwood-soc2-typeii-redacted-2025.pdf
- short FAQ/one-pager (encryption, retention, KMS, IR) — I'll produce this today.
- BAA template + DocuSign link.

Priya — if you want, I can join the technical deep-dive with VitalMed. Suggest scheduling it for next Wed/Thu afternoon PST.

-Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
